mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 6% and a fall in PAYEMS below its 3-month moving average signals labor market imbalances, which increase cost pressures and reduce hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST below their 6-month moving averages for two consecutive months signals broad-based weakness in housing and overall demand, which depresses equity valuations and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 6-month MA AND HOUST < 6-month MA for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% while CPIAUCSL rises above 3% YoY signals a failed monetary easing, which erodes real yields and boosts inflation risk, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on positive correlation exists between monthly growth in RSAFS and S&P 500 5-day forward returns, as rising household savings signal increased financial market participation and risk appetite.
failure_condition: The correlation between monthly RSAFS growth and S&P 500 5-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in out-of-sample tests.
